build_docling_document: build a DoclingDocument from a GLM-format dictionary containing page elements, figures, and tables
resolve_item_path: resolve a reference path string to retrieve a nested object from a GLM document dictionary
flatten_table_grid: flatten a nested table grid into a list of unique table cell objects by deduplicating spans
add_child_elements: add child elements like list items and headings into a container group from a payload object
convert_pdf_to_docling: convert a GLM-structured PDF extraction into a structured DoclingDocument with provenance and captions
